rules.name: Internal Password Spray
rules.description: Single source failed logons against many usernames on one destination within 5 minutes.

rules.name: Distributed Password Spray
rules.description: Multiple sources generating high volume of failed logons against one destination.

rules.name: Brute Force Single Account
rules.description: Single source repeatedly failing one username on one destination.

rules.name: Spray Then Success
rules.description: Multiple failures followed by a successful logon for the same source/username.

rules.name: Privileged Logon After Failures
rules.description: Failed logons from a source followed by successful logon and special privileges (4672).

rules.name: Suspicious Account Names
rules.description: Suspicious account names with sufficient volume (name alone does not alert).

rules.name: Multiple Internal Targets
rules.description: One source connecting to many destinations on authentication-related ports.
